title: Mesh Optimization And Retopology Toolset
description:
Welcome to the tutorial on Mesh Optimization and Retopology Toolset
- We are going to explore different features in Marvelous Designer that can help you create desired topology for your mesh.

You can find more details for each tool mentioned from the videos bellow:
